subject: Lead Testing Results and School Bus Shortages
overview: The Committee reviewed comprehensive reports on lead levels in school water fixtures and ongoing regional challenges regarding school bus driver shortages. Members discussed remediation strategies for water safety, including grant applications for new filling stations, and explored route optimization and safety protocols with the district’s transportation provider.

items.title: Subcommittee Report: Strategic Capital Planning
items.summary: Member Jenny Graham reported that the subcommittee is finalizing a draft capital plan based on principal input and HVAC needs, which will be presented for prioritization in December.

items.title: Superintendent’s Updates and Recognition
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent recognized student athletic championships, the opening of a universally accessible playground at McGlynn Elementary, and upcoming college and career information sessions.

items.title: Water Testing and Remediation Report
items.summary: Representatives from the DEP and UMass Amherst presented data showing that while many fixtures were clear, 176 exceeded the 15 parts per billion action level for lead. The district has applied for School Water Improvement Grants (SWIG) to fund filtered bottle-filling stations and is currently using signage and flushing protocols for remediation.

items.title: District-Wide Busing Report
items.summary: Eastern Bus Company representatives addressed the impact of a severe regional driver shortage on Medford's routes and discussed training efforts to secure additional staff by late autumn. The Committee discussed route optimization to reduce transit times for after-school programs and the importance of using student tags to ensure younger children are dropped off correctly.

items.title: Second Readings: Tobacco Prohibition Policies
items.summary: Approved the second readings of policies ADC and GBED, prohibiting tobacco products on school premises for all individuals and staff members.

items.title: Condolences and Upcoming Meetings
items.summary: The Committee observed a moment of silence for a community member and announced that upcoming meetings on October 28 and November 4 will be held remotely.
